title: Held-out objectives
objective: The loop must close over objectives it has never seen in any seed-0 corpus: objective identity is varied per trial seed and the loop must still be admitted AUTONOMOUS with zero human causal edges. Generalization of recurrence, not memorization of one objective id.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-trial corpus identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.epoch: pre-epoch grant of a seed-specific Objective id never reused across trials
setup.loop: identical to ALOOP-001 but every Objective/Evidence object id carries the held-out namespace
setup.heldout_rule: trial k uses seed[k]; objective ids are derived from seed[k] and appear in no other trial's corpus

acceptance_criteria: court verdict QUALIFIED for every trial seed
episode class AUTONOMOUS for every trial seed
metrics.HIR == 0.0 and UAR == 0.0 in every trial
held-out objective namespace observed in the corpus (the trial really ran on unseen ids)
falsifier: Run trial 0 against trial 1's corpus and require the objective namespaces to differ; if they do not differ, the held-out property is vacuous and the scenario is invalid.

negative_control.name: ungranted authority over a held-out objective
negative_control.requirement: a work order claiming authority that the epoch never granted over the held-out objective must be REFUSED, not scored

status_note: Synthetic corpus; measures the court's sensitivity to objective identity, not real generalization of a deployed agent.
